# Karen Ohanyan

> Biographical site of Karen Ohanyan, an Armenian painter — selected works, exhibitions, biography, and critical texts about him.

Content is organized by album/series; each artwork has its own page. Available in English and Armenian.

## Pages

- [Works](https://karenohanyan.art/en): albums/series of paintings, one page per artwork
- [Biography](https://karenohanyan.art/en/biography)
- [Exhibitions](https://karenohanyan.art/en/exhibitions): list of solo exhibitions
- [Texts](https://karenohanyan.art/en/texts): critical essays and reviews about the artist's work
- [Media](https://karenohanyan.art/en/media): video interviews and coverage
- [Contacts](https://karenohanyan.art/en/contacts)

## Sitemap

- [sitemap.xml](https://karenohanyan.art/sitemap.xml): full list of pages, including every artwork and text, in English and Armenian
